anchors.title: Bathers Way Coastal Walk
anchors.description: Six kilometres of clifftop and beach path from Nobbys Lighthouse to Merewether Ocean Baths. Six surf beaches, three ocean pools, lookouts and the South Newcastle Anzac memorial along the way.

anchors.title: Newcastle Ocean Baths
anchors.description: Art-deco 1922 ocean pool on the southern end of Newcastle Beach. Heritage-listed pavilion, two pools and a popular pump track. Free entry, lifeguard-supervised.

anchors.title: Fort Scratchley
anchors.description: 1882 coastal defence fort on Flagstaff Hill — the only Australian fort to engage an enemy warship (a Japanese submarine in 1942). Free underground tunnel tours and panoramic views over the harbour.

anchors.title: Newcastle Museum
anchors.description: Free regional museum in the heritage Honeysuckle railway workshops. Permanent industrial-history exhibits, a working steam engine, and a strong contemporary exhibitions program.

anchors.title: Honeysuckle Waterfront Dining
anchors.description: Restored 19th-century wharves on the harbour edge, now a strip of waterfront restaurants, bars and the Honeysuckle Hotel. Ten minutes' walk from Newcastle Interchange.

SUNDAY.title: Newcastle City Farmers Market
SUNDAY.description: Every Sunday morning at Newcastle Showground. 70+ Hunter Valley producers, breakfast vans and live folk music. 8am-1pm.
